name: UCP Campus Combined API
description: One Next.js server for the Flutter community app (Supabase) and the Live Grading extension (MongoDB under /api/ext/*).

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Supabase service_role key (server only, never commit).

ODOO_BASE.description: Odoo/Horizon base URL for session verification.

CORS_ORIGIN.description: Allowed CORS origin, * for pilot or exact origin.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB URI for /api/ext/* (extension). Unset = ext routes 503, community unaffected.

BASE_URL.description: Public host, used in earn referral links.

CUTY_API_TOKEN.description: Cuty.io token for referral short links (unset = long URLs).
